description: Implementation of the ObservationBuffer class for managing network quality observations, including adding observations, computing percentiles, and filtering observations based on source and timestamp.

classes.name: ObservationBuffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer of network quality observations, allowing addition, percentile calculation, and filtering based on source and timestamp.

methods.name: ObservationBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the observation buffer with parameters, clock, and weight multipliers.

methods.name: AddObservation
methods.description: Adds a new observation to the buffer, maintaining order and size constraints.

methods.name: GetPercentile
methods.description: Calculates the percentile value of observations filtered by timestamp and signal strength.

methods.name: ComputeWeightedObservations
methods.description: Computes weighted observations based on time and signal strength, used for percentile calculations.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size from parameters.
